children: Quaint Oak Bancorp appointed Ray S. Greenberg as a director and named him to the Audit Committee, effective September 9, 2026.
Served on Bank Board since 2016; Advisory Board member May 2017–Sep 2026; owner of Financial Expertise; CFP since 1990; decades of financial services experience; committee service experience.
Appointed to Company Audit Committee; Chair of Bank Board's Compliance Oversight, Loan and Pandemic Committees; member of those committees.
